'''Project TG-5''' were mutated [[Flesh Raider]]s and personal experiments of [[Rasmus Blys]] and [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[CZ-198]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Contained within tanks of unknown content, the subjects, when released, would discharge a pheromone that attracted [[Project EK-8]]. When both projects made contact the results were an explosive force that killed both subjects.
